title: Total Must Equal 100%
text: The four DNA bases (A, T, G, C) together must make up 100% of the nitrogenous bases in the molecule.

title: Calculate Remaining Percentage
text: First, find A + T = 22% + 22% = 44%. This means G + C = 100% - 44% = 56%.

title: Apply G=C Rule
